system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Owing to the functional variation among executors, a tailored design approach is necessary for each executor, depending on the specific tools available to them.
system_prompt_style.note: Per-role prompt structures (Fig. 2); the task and sub-task text are inserted into them. The code is withheld, so the rendering mechanism is not visible.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The benchmark assesses the ability of language agents to (1) efficiently gather necessary information using appropriate tools
env_context_strategy.note: The executors gather information through tool calls. There is no repository to confirm this.

context_compaction.note: The source code is withheld (README). The paper does not describe history compaction. The supervisor passes only neighbor outcomes, but this is by design, not a compaction mechanism.

observation_format.note: The code is not released. The paper does not describe the observation format.

tool_call_format.note: The paper mentions function calls but not the call syntax. The code is withheld.

tool_count.note: The tool lists are benchmark-specific and not enumerated. The code is withheld.

edit_primitive.note: The tasks are travel planning and API use, with no file editing described. There is no tool registry available.

protocol_standardization.note: The code is withheld, so there are no dependencies to grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: PMC is the first plan-and-execute method for collaborative LLM-based multi-agent systems
loop_primitives.note: The executors use ReAct for step-level execution (Sec. 4.2).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: PMC simplifies complex task planning by breaking it down into a hierarchy of subordinate tasks, each achievable through a series of (heterogeneous) tool calls.
planning_granularity.note: The plan is a sub-task graph G=(V,E).

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: PMC comprises a manager agent for task decomposition and a fleet of executor agents to perform sub-tasks.
multi_agent_topology.note: There are also supervisor and deliverer agents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The manager agent assigns each sub-task to an executor agent, which has access to various heterogeneous tools
delegation_mechanism.note: The paper describes 'executor as tools'. Whether new agent instances are created is unknown; this is the closest value.

human_in_loop.note: The paper says the sub-task graph offers 'potential human intervention', but no gating mechanism is described.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: PMC represents them via a directed graph G = (V,E), termed sub-task graph.

self_verification.note: The supervisor refines sub-tasks but does not verify them. The code is withheld.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: For all benchmarks, each instance is executed only once without sampling
retry_policy.note: This describes the experimental protocol, not a harness mechanism.

termination_condition.note: The 30-step limit is a benchmark delivery criterion, not a harness termination condition. The deliverer ends the pipeline, but the harness termination code is withheld.

eval_hooks.note: The repository contains only LICENSE and README, so no eval runner is available to inspect. The paper evaluates on TravelPlanner and API-Bank.

target_domain.evidence_quote: we examine its efficacy in the domains of itinerary planning (Xie et al., 2024) and daily tools using (Li et al., 2023).
target_domain.note: The system is aimed at travel planning and API use; there is no closer value.

open_source.evidence_quote: Due to the privacy policy of Huawei, we can not reveal the source code.
open_source.note: A LICENSE file exists, but its contents were not shown.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: we employ LLaMA-3.1-8B as the planner and GPT-4 as the executor
model_agnostic.note: GPT-3.5, GPT-4 and LLaMA-3.1-8B were all used. The client abstraction is unknown.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Due to the privacy policy of Huawei, we can not reveal the source code.

first_release_date.note: There are no tags, first commit or paper v1 date in the evidence. The paper v4 is dated 16 Dec 2024.

pinned_version.note: No tag exists, and only the short hash is available.

stars.note: The date of the star count is not stated; the evidence bundle was used.
